# Apidog

> > Apidog is an all-in-one API development platform for design, debugging, mocking, testing, and documentation generation.

Apidog provides a comprehensive API lifecycle management solution supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, and gRPC protocols. It serves as a Postman alternative with enhanced collaboration features, AI-powered capabilities, and support for OpenAPI/Swagger standards.

## Key Topics

- API Testing
- API Documentation
- API Design
- API Mocking
- API Debugging
- Postman Alternative
- OpenAPI/Swagger
- JSON Schema
- WebSocket
- GraphQL
- gRPC
- Collaboration Tools
- Automated Testing
- AI-Powered Features
- Custom Domains
